description: Six independently labelled V5 ladder errors from rounds 46, 47, 48, and 50. This compact suite is for mechanism diagnosis, not Elo estimation.

positions.label: Elbow Grease, White move 20
positions.diagnosis: V5 played Be3 and allowed ...Bxf3, worsening an already uncomfortable middlegame by roughly 109 cp; Be2 keeps the bishop and pawn structure coordinated.

positions.label: Keep Kann and Caro On, Black move 11
positions.diagnosis: V5 played Qd7 instead of the centralising Nd4, swinging from a small advantage to a clear disadvantage by roughly 150 cp.

positions.label: Keresight, Black move 49
positions.diagnosis: V5 spent only about 1.24 seconds despite having 41.5 seconds left and played Kg8 in an equal ending. The move loses by force; Kh7 holds.

positions.label: The Castle Gambit, Black move 35
positions.diagnosis: After White's 35.Rg4 blunder, V5 immediately returned most of an approximately three-pawn advantage with 35...Rff7 instead of 35...Qd7, a loss of roughly 239 cp.

positions.label: The Castle Gambit, Black move 44
positions.diagnosis: V5 played 44...Qc4 instead of the forcing 44...b4 while still holding about 45 seconds, surrendering roughly 161 cp and its renewed winning chances.

positions.label: The Castle Gambit, Black move 81
positions.diagnosis: In an equal queen ending, V5 played 81...Qh1 instead of 81...Qd6+ and fell to roughly -1.2 despite retaining about 26 seconds.
